h1: Custom stickers and labels in Ticino
heroParagrafi: We produce custom stickers and labels in Ticino: cut vinyl, printed and laminated, resin-domed, UV DTF and magnetic. Long-lasting solutions for shop windows, vehicles, products and packaging.
Our resin-domed labels, with their raised 3D effect and glossy finish, stand up to UV rays and solvents: perfect for machinery, equipment and for adding value to your brand.
Rounding out the range are our labels for bottles, cosmetics and food packaging, made to measure for your visual identity. Free quote in 24/48h.
claimArancione: With solutions suited to every sector, we can support you in producing promotional items, packaging and large-scale communications.
whatsappTesto: Hi VAM Deco, I would like a quote for custom stickers / labels.
beneficiTitolo: Why choose custom stickers in Ticino
beneficiIntro: Give your brand visibility and make it stand out with high-quality stickers and labels, custom made for your business. Thanks to our experience and advanced printing techniques, we offer solutions for every need, from corporate branding to the finest packaging details.

benefici.testo: Cut-out letters and logos with no background, perfect for shop windows, vehicles and signs: clean application, a professional look and great impact even from a distance.
Vivid full-colour printing protected by scratch- and UV-resistant lamination: custom stickers that last for years outdoors, on shop windows, vehicles and equipment.
Resin-domed labels with a raised, glossy 3D finish, resistant to UV rays and solvents: ideal for machinery, equipment and brand logos.
UV DTF technology for high-definition custom stickers that adhere even to challenging surfaces: plastic, wood, metal, glass and curved objects.
Custom magnetic panels for company vehicles and metal surfaces: applied and removed in seconds, reusable and leaving no residue on the bodywork.
Custom labels for wine and beer bottles, cosmetics and food packaging: resistant to moisture, oils and temperature, with professional made-to-measure finishes.

fasi.d: We dive into your needs and goals: whether stickers for vehicles and shop windows or labels for your products, we work closely with you to understand exactly what you want to achieve.
We put together a free, tailored quote, choosing the technologies and materials best suited to the job. We create designs that reflect your brand, capture attention and enhance your image.
Once the project is approved, our state-of-the-art equipment handles production and, where needed, application at our premises or yours, with precision and on schedule.
When the project is complete, we run a detailed check to ensure the required quality standards. We stay on hand with ongoing support until you are completely satisfied.

faq.domanda: What types of stickers do you offer?
faq.risposta: We offer a wide range of stickers, including cut vinyl, printed, resin-domed, laminated, UV-printed and UV DTF stickers, ideal for every need.

faq.domanda: What is the difference between cut vinyl, resin-domed and printed stickers?
faq.risposta: Cut vinyl stickers are precision cut with no background, perfect for application on glass. Resin-domed stickers have a three-dimensional finish thanks to a protective resin. Printed stickers can be produced in a range of formats and customised with colourful graphics.

faq.domanda: How long do stickers last outdoors? Are they weatherproof?
faq.risposta: Yes, our laminated stickers are engineered to withstand the elements and last on average 3 to 6 years outdoors, thanks to water- and UV-resistant materials.

faq.domanda: Which stickers are best for transparent surfaces such as glass or windows?
faq.risposta: Cut vinyl and transparent stickers are ideal for glass surfaces, as they let you see through the sticker without compromising visibility.

faq.domanda: How much do custom stickers cost?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the type, size and quantity of the order. We provide tailored quotes to guarantee the best value for money.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to produce custom stickers?
faq.risposta: Production time varies with the complexity and quantity of the order. As a rule, excluding resin-domed and UV DTF stickers, production takes 2 to 4 working days.

faq.domanda: How do I choose the right type of sticker or label for my project?
faq.risposta: Our team is on hand to recommend the best solution based on the intended use and the surface you will apply the sticker or label to. Get in touch for a free, personalised consultation.
